title: a red proof's pytest traceback mints no tooth
intention: teeth_printed reads no tooth from the source lines pytest echoes inside a failure traceback, so a red proof whose failing function's docstring has an indented line opening with a report word never adds that line to teeth_green or teeth_red; pytest's short test summary and every line before the FAILURES rule read as now.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: 09f5cc38e16f's red-first seal (cairn/devices/tester/validations/test_the_hollow_reads_a_tooth_this_host_cannot_run_as_unread.json at a071e6b10, entry 0, red) lists teeth_green ['for the wrong reason. A reverted file can red a tooth two ways: the tooth ran and']. pytest's FAILURES section echoed run_all's source from cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, whose docstring line 1198 opens with 'green', indented, and _MARKER_LABEL (cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py:103) reads any indented line opening with a report word as a tooth. A declared tooth cannot be greened this way (the name is never a test_ identifier), but the seal records a green tooth nobody measured.
traces_to: Law 8 (a tooth minted from echoed source is coverage evidence a hollow build could carry) and Law 3 (the seal's teeth are a measurement and record only what was measured)
how: In cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py teeth_printed, before the label patterns read the stdout, drop the traceback body pytest prints between the '= FAILURES =' (and '= ERRORS =') rule and the next '=' rule ('short test summary info', or the end), keeping the summary itself. A red-first proof calls teeth_printed over a stdout that reports one ok tooth, then a FAILURES section echoing an indented 'green for the wrong reason.' docstring line, then the short summary's FAILED line.

clauses.claim: a stdout whose pytest FAILURES section echoes an indented line opening 'green for the wrong reason.' yields no tooth named from that line in green or red
in the same stdout, the indented 'ok   test_a' line printed before the FAILURES rule still reads green, and the short summary's 'FAILED x.py::test_b' still reads test_b red
a stdout with no FAILURES rule parses exactly as before: an indented 'ok   some label' line still mints the label tooth 'some label' green

decisions.text: D1: cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py teeth_printed strips the body of each pytest '= FAILURES =' or '= ERRORS =' section, from its rule up to the next line of '=' rule or the end, before its patterns run; the short test summary section is not stripped. Its comment cites this ticket and the 09f5 measurement.

D2: the red-first proof cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_a_red_proofs_traceback_mints_no_tooth.py, PROVES ed053ecf8b83 keys 1-3, one tooth per clause, calling teeth_printed over inline stdout strings in the fixture shape of cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_a_green_proofs_data_row_mints_no_label_tooth.py; no subprocess, no scratch repo.

constraints: pytest's short test summary stays read: it is how a red tooth gets its name
lines a proof prints before the FAILURES rule parse exactly as now (8e2018855b31, 8f5ab45e64c5, 9ac5f5e882f1 stand)
this lands after 9ac5f5e882f1 (PROVEME:waiting, same function), so 9ac5's seal is not staled mid-voyage

out: a 'Captured stdout' section pytest prints without -s: not measured in the sealed tails; if a proof's report lines are found there, that is a new ticket

measured.saw: 09f5cc38e16f's red-first seal entry 0 (red, 17:01:57) has teeth_green ['for the wrong reason. A reverted file can red a tooth two ways: the tooth ran and'], the tail of cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py:1198's docstring line
measured.how: akienasus_cc_0 read cairn/devices/tester/validations/test_the_hollow_reads_a_tooth_this_host_cannot_run_as_unread.json at a071e6b10 and git grep on hollow.py

measured.saw: _MARKER_LABEL = ^(?:[ \t]+([A-Za-z]+)[ \t]+|([A-Za-z]+)[ \t]*:[ \t]+)(\S.*?)[ \t]*$ reads an indented line opening with a report word; 'green' is a report word
measured.how: read of cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py:103-168 on akiendelllinux; cc_0 measured the same diagnosis independently

measured.saw: over 842 sealed validation entries in the house, 2 stdout tails hold a FAILURES rule; teeth_printed mints 2 teeth after it, both test_-named from the short summary, and 0 label teeth (tails are truncated, so this bounds only what was stored)
